_comment: Shared by scripts/scenarios.py (live smoke) and scripts/eval.py (in-process eval). Each fact is a list of accepted alternatives; {"brl": "1817.26"} expands to its pt-BR/en spellings. Support facts come from data/merchants.json (cliente1988); Knowledge facts only where stable on the Corpus. Refusals and web-search scenarios declare none. Mixed questions list intents_needed; their intent is the part today's single-intent Router should pick. "user_id": null is an anonymous visitor (no token): products answered, account questions get the fixed login reply (facts check it). Optional agent: the expected agent in the reply (escalator for an Escalation, router for the anonymous login reply); routing passes only if it matches too.
